name: Manufacturer
rationale: Identity attribute necessary for distinguishing products from different manufacturers.

name: Part number
rationale: Essential for product identification and differentiation within a manufacturer's catalog.

name: Rated operational voltage
rationale: Critical for defining the electrical capacity of the switch, as specified in IEC standards.

name: Rated operational current
rationale: Defines the electrical load capacity, essential for distinguishing product variants.

name: Number of poles
rationale: Determines the switch's ability to control multiple circuits, affecting its application.

name: Mounting type
rationale: Affects the physical integration of the switch into systems, important for variant differentiation.

name: Degree of protection (IP)
rationale: Describes environmental resilience, critical for determining suitability in various conditions.

name: Dimensions (H x W x D)
rationale: Important for physical integration and space considerations in installations.

name: Weight
rationale: Relevant for handling and installation, though not variant-defining.

name: Operating temperature range
rationale: Critical for ensuring the switch functions properly in its intended environment.

name: Mechanical life
rationale: Indicates durability and reliability, important for lifecycle assessment.

name: Contact configuration
rationale: Defines the switch's functionality and application, critical for variant differentiation.

name: Type of actuation
rationale: Affects user interaction and application, important for distinguishing product variants.

name: Short-circuit rating
rationale: Indicates the switch's ability to handle fault conditions, important for safety assessments.

name: Material
rationale: Affects durability and environmental suitability, though not variant-defining.

name: Color
rationale: Primarily aesthetic, not critical for function or variant differentiation.
